summary: The CI job runs Go 1.25.14 while the project's go.mod requires Go >= 1.27.0, causing golangci-lint to fail when loading packages.

citations.text: level=error msg="Running error: context loading failed: failed to load packages: failed to load packages: failed to load with go/packages: err: exit status 1: stderr: go: go.mod requires go >= 1.27.0 (running go 1.25.14; GOTOOLCHAIN=local)\n"
